interpretation: The archived full run stopped after unrelated Web baseline failures; no Continuum test failed. The two settings golden failures caused by newly shipped license links were corrected and their targeted rerun passed 2/2. This still is not evidence that the full Web suite passes.

remediation.targetedCommand: pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.web.config.ts run apps/web/tests/settings-chrome.e2e.ts -t 'opens a browser asking for no shipped language in English|hides link-opening settings when the built-in browser is disabled'
